programme.title: 月黑風高
programme.desc: Michael Chow is the chief cop of Tai O, a small rural town on Hong Kong's outlying Lantau Island. When a local man turns up dead, urban hero cop Michael Wong is sent in to help out the locals... and what follows is a cultural clash that's both humorous and utterly entertaining! Wong is an SDU cop and takes to bullying the locals with tough and hard-handed ways, but his efforts only result in resentment and anger. It's Chow who gets what the odd residents of Tai O are about, and his lackadaisical attitude is just what's needed to handle the prickly locals. But it may take the skills of both men to solve this murder case! Though nominally a cop film, this unique creation is as much a comedy of cultural errors as a murder mystery.

programme.title: 霹靂大喇叭
programme.desc: Tuba is a policeman, but because of his timid character, he spends his days in the Police Band as a tuba player. Inspector Chow sees the potential in Tuba and arranges him to investigate the case together. Unfortunately, Chow gets killed at work, but his ghost helps Tuba to crackdown on the villains..

programme.title: 賭聖2之街頭賭聖
programme.desc: Lui puts forward a masked Saint of gamblers to cover for him in the casino. Meanwhile, Uncle Sam sets out in search of the new Saint since the real saint of gamblers retires..

programme.title: 小男人周記
programme.desc: Leung Foon is one of those youthful, upward-moving people. He is 33, middle rung officer of an advertising agency, and has been married eight years to Ann. Ann holds down a key post in a finance company. She also likes to manage Foon's life. The couple has been drifting apart. A quarrel and the two decide to separate. Q-Taro and Big Cheat, Foon's colleagues and close friends, like to fool around. Q is married to the city shrew while Big Cheat's wife puts him above everything else. Foon has a new boss, Mrs. Lam who wants to rid the agency of useless employees. She forces Foon to fire Q-Taro..

programme.title: 蠍子戰士
programme.desc: Fei comes to Hong Kong with his son Yushu and winds up a back-alley barber. Yushu is now in high school but he only likes to draw pictures. He also is hot blooded, thus often getting into fights. By accident, Yushu meets beautiful Ru. He learns that Inspector Hua and underworld boss Wang are working together in prostitution and human traffic. Yushu helps Ru to escape from Wang 's catches. Fei, Yushu and Ru are being haunted by Hua's men, but are saved by self-styled kungfu master Jean-Paul. They are taken in by Master Yi and asks Yushu to prepare the beef noodles but he only wants to learn kungfu from Jean-Paul. However, Yushu realizes Master Yi actually is the kungfu master. He begs Master Yi to teach him the skills and fight against evil forces together..

programme.title: 想飛
programme.desc: When Joker meets Ling in a disco one night, he feels she is the perfect model of his dream project 'princess-d'. In reality, however, Ling is the opposite of the perfect image..

programme.title: 風雨同路
programme.desc: Undercover cop Cheung Long is instructed to take up the identity as convict to get acquainted to Lee Wan Fay who is a stolen goods dealer. In the course of escaping from Big Mad, an opponent of Fay, both Long and Fay grow a good feeling towards each other. When Long's supervisor wants to use Fay to bait Big Mad, Long saves Fay and tells him the truth..

programme.title: 太子傳說
programme.desc: Cheung is Prince, the son of crime boss Mr. Pak in the underworld. He kills flamboyantly with the help of partner Ching Ching, who was a gift from Mr. Pak many years ago. Still, despite Ching's constant companionship, Prince longs for a woman he has seen in his dreams since youth. The dream girl is a dancer Tweedy. He also longs to kill Drago, who was supposedly responsible for taking his mother away. Dragon actually has his own vendetta against Pak, as Pak kidnapped his son many years ago. The missing son turns up, and he's now a killer who goes by the name of Prince.

programme.title: 火燒紅蓮寺
programme.desc: Rumors have it that the Shaolin Temple is harbouring revolutionaries. The emperor believes the rumors and decides to wipe out the temple. Fong Sai-yuk escapes with his uncle to the desert. There they run into Tou Tou. Yuk's uncle is killed by the king's general, and Tou and Yuk are captured. They are taken to the Red Lotus Temple; the temple is run by Elder Kung. Hung Hei Koon, has already joined Elder Kung and voluntarily becomes his protege. Yuk looks for every chance to escape but is stopped by Koon and Koon is just pretending to have joined Elder Kung. With Koon's help, Yuk finally defeats Elder Kung..

programme.desc: Lawrence Cheng has been working in the film industry over 40 years who was known with his friends in the 1980s as the creator of The Yuppie Fantasia franchise. In this episode, Cheng shares his motive of creation and key to success of such franchise, as well as how he got obsessed with film as teen. Looking back, he admits that he was not a very competent director and reveals more unforgettable stories of the past.

programme.title: 英雄本色II
programme.desc: Former criminal, Tse-Ho is set free from his incarceration in jail to assist in the investigation of his former crime boss, Lung, who is suspected of running a counterfeit operation. Though initially refusing, he only agrees so he can keep a close eye on his cop brother Kit, who is working undercover to infiltrate Lung's organization. After Lung is framed for the murder of a rival gang leader, he turns to Tse-Ho, who helps him escape to New York where he is joined by Ken, the equally deadly twin brother of the deceased Mark. Returning to Hong Kong to rejoin Tse-Ho and Kit, they soon discover the true mastermind behind the entire operation, and in true John Woo fashion, set out to take him down.

programme.desc: Wing and Fat have the same burning ambition to be big in the underworld. They struggle and are doing very well, so well the kingpin of the gangs wants to get rid of them. Wing and Fat are forced to fight back, then the showdown comes..

While KAU was very hasty, he killed all CHEUNG's family. Then, CHEUNG wanted to take revenge against them. However, MA and KAU made a plan to get CHEUNG into trouble. At last, CHEUNG escaped to Thailand and stayed at his aunt's house. MA and KAU knew that CHEUNG escaped to Thailand, so they tried their best to kill him, but they did not succeed..

programme.title: 整蠱王
programme.desc: Happy specializes in playing tricks, but he refuses to work for rich man Shi. By coincidence, Happy meets Moon and falls for her. However, he is not aware it is just a trick..

programme.title: 名劍
programme.desc: Swords, like diamonds, sometimes carry a curse. And the famous sword Chi Mud is such a sword. When swordmaster Wah acquires Chi Mud, he is advised to destroy it or he will be killed by this very sword. Wah does not listen. He has already retired into seclusion and does not think the young swordsmen can find and challenge him. Li is such a young swordsman. He even has dueled and killed another young challenger. Li by accident saves a young girl from a professional killer. In a few days, the girl and Li become friends. But the girl leaves in anger when Li meets his old flame Hsiao Yue, now married to Lin Wan. Li is ambushed by killer Chan..

programme.title: 祝您好運
programme.desc: Mr. and Mrs. Cao had an heirloom, a valuable diamond named “LUCKY STAR”. They insured the diamond for a large sum of money then hired four gangsters to rob it in order to cheat the insurance company for the compensation. However, when the gangsters got the diamond, one of them intended to possess the diamond alone but was discovered by the others. They were very angry and wanted to kill him. He escaped into Zhi's house and put the diamond into the facial cream of Zhi and then quitted. Unluckily, Zhi was mistaken by the other three that she was his member and helped to receive the loot. So Zhi was involved in the case and was attacked by the three gangsters but fortunately she could escape with her tricks..

programme.title: 五虎將之決裂
programme.desc: 5 CID members are good friends and form a cooperative team in difficult cases. But the 'Five Tigers' gets blackmailed by the villain and questioned by ICAC for the missing money..

programme.desc: By the early twenty centuries, there was a great disaster in Guang Xi. The myth of ghosts and plagues were overwhelmingly perplexed people in the Phoenix City. In order to ease the pain of the villagers, a medical group were commanded to stay in the Church of the Phoenix City. Unfortunately, the church was actually the home of the ghosts..

programme.desc: The Joker travels back in time to save his beloved, the reformed devil Boney M. But instead of the right place and right time, he finds himself stranded in five hundred years back..

A Chinese traitor Tung working within the puppet state of Manchukuo, gets involved in an affair with the mistress of a military officer. Their affair is exposed and in the confusion, Tung kills the officer and has to flee from the Japanese. In the desolate arid lands, his life is saved by Iron Sister, a member of guerrillas from a nearby hunting village, whom has an affair later with Tung. The humble villagers are very simple minded and only wished to drive out the Japanese. They fall easy prey, as Tung disguises his real identity and continues his secret contacts with his collaborators. One by one, the villagers become victims of Tung's ploy. Accidentally his plot is discovered by Iron Sister and they engage in a battle of life and death.

However, Cheng was repeatedly able to escape. Train service between Shanghai and Chengdu was launched. The first train carried many high officials and noble lords including a Japanese envoy with the national treasure. It drew the attention of Shanghai triads colluding with gangsters to plunder the treasure. The train was forced to stop at Hanshui town due to the railroad was exploded by Cheng..

No wonder police chief Yuan Kuei becomes suspicious. He thinks he is sitting on top of a narcotics ring. His two men are ordered to watch closely movement of the opera people. Little does the chief know that actually the islanders are living off the loot their ancestors made by raiding a government gold galleon some centuries ago. They buried much of the treasure and a dormant vampire under a pagoda. Two actresses and a tutor from the troupe get to the pagoda by accident, followed by the three policemen..

programme.title: 賭俠1999
programme.desc: King, the Con Man, is regarded as the successor of God of Gamblers. Dragon opts for gambling and approaches King, hoping to learn gambling tricks from him..

programme.title: 慌心假期
programme.desc: Michele takes off for Europe to contemplate her inevitable divorce. She meets the beautiful Miki, a Japanese model who tries to end a relationship with a married man. There is nothing like love trouble to foster a quick bond and the women become close friends. However, during an evening of drunken revelry, Miki discloses by accident that she is the other woman of Michele's husband..

programme.title: 富貴列車
programme.desc: During the early reign of Republic of China, Cheng Fong Tin conducted speculative business in the Northeast frontier. Chinese Government sent secret agent Laifu to pursue him. However, Cheng was repeatedly able to escape. Train service between Shanghai and Chengdu was launched. The first train carried many high officials and noble lords including a Japanese envoy with the national treasure. It drew the attention of Shanghai triads colluding with gangsters to plunder the treasure. The train was forced to stop at Hanshui town due to the railroad was exploded by Cheng..

programme.title: BEYOND日記之莫欺少年窮
programme.desc: This is the story of four aspiring young men striving to fight for their own goals. Kui and his family are intent upon emigrating to another country and they put all their energy in making as much money as possible in order to leave Hong Kong sooner. However just as their goal is about in sight, over-exertion causes Kui to fall ill...Keung is a smart and aggressive young man whose ambition is to make it in the world. But misfortune descends upon him when discovering that he and his family are duped by his boss...It has been a childhood dream of Chung to join the police force but his fragile frame of a body is far from satisfactory, so he turns to conducting traffic and handing out tickets to unfortunate drivers amid the bustles of the streets. However, his virtue is not appreciated...Wing is a diligent and self-absorbed student. His goal is to be one of the chosen few at his college's Music Department but he is dissuaded by his girlfriend's father. In the end he gives in and.

programme.title: 殭屍先生
programme.desc: Mr. Yan calls in Chinese voodoo priest Kou to handle the reburial of his dad. The corpse rises and becomes a vampire. It first kills Mr. Yan and roams about for new victims..

programme.title: 天若有情
programme.desc: Wah Dee handles cars and bikes like a racing champion. To keep the police off his trail, he takes Jo Jo hostage. On the run, their desperate love is doomed from the start...

programme.title: 天若有情II之天長地久
programme.desc: Celia sneaks into Hong Kong to save her brother. Unfortunately, she gets involved in a triad murder and meets Frank at this time and a loving relationship develops..

programme.title: 大冒險家
programme.desc: 20 years ago, in the region of Golden Triangle, Wah(aged about 9) and his parents, his god father (Keung) with his daughter (aged about 5) planned to smuggle some valuable items and information into Thailand. Wah's father, Keung and Leung were the closest of friends, just like blood brothers, all 3 of them were C.I.A. agents. Keung left for Thailand before the others to plan the operation. Leung ganged up with some bandits and forced Wah's father to surrender the confidential information. Wah, hidden in the dark, saw his parents being killed. 20 years later, Wah became an officer in the Thai Air Force. He couldn't take his mind off the revenge. Leung became a successful business man. He was in Thailand to launch a major business project. Ignoring Keung's advise, Wah and Roy slipped into Leung's hotel to try to assassinate him..

programme.title: 伊波拉病毒
programme.desc: Ten years ago, Kai, a local gangster was caught in bed with his boss's wife, he killed both the boss and his wife. The boss's daughter Lily witnessed the murders and managed to escape afterwards. As the police were looking for him, Kai was forced to disappear... For the last ten years, Kai has worked in a Chinese restaurant in Johannesburg in South Africa after being smuggled into the country. The restaurant owner Brother Kei and his wife Ling take advantage of Kai's situation and treat him badly. One day Kai goes to buy meat from a native tribe, he is unaware of that a terrible epidemic – the Ebola virus has broken out among the tribesmen. During the trip Kai rapes and murders a black girl who is infected with the disease. Kai has no idea he is carrying the disease, his body creates an antibody which means he is a carrier but the disease won't affect him..

programme.title: 屍家重地
programme.desc: On a remote island off Hong Kong, its rich and happy inhabitants are celebrating an annual ritual by staging an operatic show. The island is not productive but its people are rich. No wonder police chief Yuan Kuei becomes suspicious. He thinks he is sitting on top of a narcotics ring. His two men are ordered to watch closely movement of the opera people. Little does the chief know that actually the islanders are living off the loot their ancestors made by raiding a government gold galleon some centuries ago. They buried much of the treasure and a dormant vampire under a pagoda. Two actresses and a tutor from the troupe get to the pagoda by accident, followed by the three policemen..

He reveals the story behind the film's directorial position and the obstacles he encountered along the production, as well as talking about his delicate sense of portraying women's stories.

programme.desc: Billie Yuen and her two friends Liao Yu Ping and Zhao Shu Ling who came from Taiwan, share the same ideal to become famous. The three women met Tony Cheung who is the son of a rice wholesaler at a bar. Tony was madly clung to the indifferent dressing Billie and then they cohabit. The four friends spent a good night at Liao's home, celebrating her birthday. One night, when Liao came home late, Zhao was found being murdered. Liao was filled with great sorrow. The three friends received Sergeant Lan's inquiry individually. Liao felt depressed since her best friend conceals everything. Tony accompanied Liao back home, the sight stroke a chord in her heart and Tony tried hard to comfort her, then they had sex. Liao was pregnant, it shocked Billie, whereas Tony felt difficult to choose. Finally both Liao and Billie left Tony and the three noticed the one they love the most is-themselves.

programme.desc: Hong Kong's police force boasts of two of the world's finest anti-crime task forces-the Flying Tigers and the Banshees. After Madam Hu and her Banshees have put ringleaders of a notorious jewelry gang behind the bars, they return to routine training. New recruits to the Banshees – Joey, Phoebe, Ding and Susanna – soon blend themselves into the daily pursuit for tougher and fun. Lo, the anti-terrorist expert, is to inspect the Tigers and Banshees. A strengthened diet of training is introduced amid the moans and groans. Before long, the jewelry robbers escape to a deserted island. The Tigers and Banshees are ordered to capture them..

programme.title: 著牛仔褲的鍾馗
programme.desc: Tsu, a police officer, has a happy life with his wife, who's pregnant. But one day when he gets a tip that a bank is about to be robbed, he rushes to it but killed. The hostage Gucci then holds the loot. Tsu becomes a vampire when a cat jumps on his body and is hit by lightning. Not until he went to the hospital did he realize he was dead and needs electric recharge to be alive. In order to keep his wife from being sad, he doesn't tell her the truth. Even when his best friend Mr. Big and Gucci find it out, he asks them to keep in secret. To get back the loot, the robbers seize both Gucci and Tsu's wife, forcing Tsu to bring the loot to exchange them..

programme.title: 倚天屠龍記之魔教教主
programme.desc: The film is originated from a famous Chinese Kung Fu fiction. Everybody fought for a pair of super weapons and wished to be the conqueror..

programme.title: 人嚇鬼
programme.desc: In a touring opera group, the domineering star is hated by all. The lesser actors try to give him a bad time by posing as ghosts. Their antics attract the attention of a real ghost who comes to make fun of them. Stage old hand Seng soon discovers the mischievous ghost met a violent death. Seng promises to find his remains and bury him. Unwittingly, Seng buries the wrong bones which belong to the Vicious Ghost. The Vicious Ghost comes and leaves a trail of violence..

programme.title: 我愛一碌葛
programme.desc: Kudzu, Mud Carp and Bean depend on each other for survival since their parents died. Kudzu, the eldest of three sisters, gave up her studies and runs a fish stall in Luen Yee Hui market to raise her two young sisters. She is a super fan of the famous Singer, Alex. Mud Carp, the second sister, becomes a lawyer after university. Her boyfriend, David, comes from a rich family. In view of this, she dares not tell David her family background even though they are planning to get married. Kudzu always hopes her youngest sister Bean, to further her studies but she falls in love with a middle-aged butcher, Wing. One day, Kudzu discovers that her good friend, Keung, has a long-lost brother, and comes to the hopeful conclusion that his lost brother is Alex. In the process of helping Keung to find his brother, the relationship between the three sisters changed..

programme.title: 奇謀妙計五福星
programme.desc: The five met in prison, Teapot, Exhaust Pipe, Vaseline, Curly Jack and Larry became friends and they would stay clean from now on. In fact they formed a cleaning company and worked hard at it after their release. Little did they realize they were released together with Boss Chan of the feared underworld who immediately reactivated his money counterfeit operation..

programme.title: 精裝追女仔
programme.desc: Fred, foul-mouthed, together with his two close buddies, Silver and Tony, are working in a garage. Their boss, Ken, is harsh and dingy. However, a warm and close friendship has been established among the four. In order to recover the heartbreak of Fred, Ken suggested a tour to Penang to cheer up Fred. They came across two beautiful girls, Maggie and Agnes, strolling leisurely on the beach as if they were very wealthy. Since then they decided on courtship. They played a poker game to decide who's to who. And Fred, the winner, chose Maggie to be his sole target. By the rules of the game, Ken, Silver and Tong have to compete to see who in the ends will win the heart of Agnes..

programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: Showdown of the Unbeatables 第1季
programme.desc: This episode of Showdown of the Unbeatables features Brooklyn Bedding memory foam versus the Dynapac CC722 roller; a peanut detecting dog versus the Vortexx Pressure Washer; and Blendtec blenders versus the indestructible Bash sledgehammer.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: On a wild and dangerous adventure to Mexico, BMX bikers Rooftop and Catfish test how gutsy they really are. The pair go from racing bikes to racing donkeys, flame throwing and tricking in pointy shoes on the streets, to loosing their breakfast trying to eat eyeball tacos for lunch. But the duo’s bravery (or stupidity) doesn’t end there. They compete in a rodeo, milk a snake for its venom, spin upside down as Voladores in a traditional rain ceremony, and get tattoos right before diving into the city’s toxic sewage. With all of these dauntless activities the question becomes, can Rooftop and Catfish make it out of Mexico in one piece.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: Rooftop and Catfish’s travels take them to Romania, where the daredevil acts continue. After a chariot race in the countryside, the BMX bikers continue their attempt to become Romanian gladiators by flying through the air, jumping through flaming walls, and even lighting themselves on fire while riding their bikes. They get up close and personal with the sheep of the country, trying the Romanian delicacy of sheep’s head, but quickly move on to just milking the animal. Finally, the trip to this Eastern European country is not complete without trying to clean up the streets from Romania’s stray dog epidemic. Are Rooftop and Catfish able to save the strays or does the duo learn that they are all bark and no bite.

programme.title: Don't Drive Here 第1季
programme.desc: It may be the backpacker's must-see, but if you go to the Venice of the East, don't drive.

programme.title: David Attenborough A Life on Earth 第1季
programme.sub-title: David Attenborough: A Life on Earth
programme.desc: The incredible journey and illustrious career of one of the most travelled men in history, this documentary tells the story of how Sir David Attenborough came to be the voice of modern natural history programs by bringing the natural world into our homes.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In the first part of the episode, Andy explores sustainable kingfish farming in Spencer Gulf, South Australia, visiting Clean Seas sea farm and preparing fresh kingfish sashimi with the team. Moving to Kangaroo Island, he learns pickling techniques with Kate from Kangaroo Island Source, showcasing her products in a Carne Asada Taco. The episode continues with Andy exploring d'Arenberg's multi-function building and 'The Cube,' experiencing a Chef's Table, and concludes at Wirra Wirra winery, where he cooks Yogurt Flatbread with Olive Oil and Dukka, enjoying it with the staff and their wines.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In Kakadu National Park, Andy joins Dewayne Webb foraging pandanus and cooking Seared Buffalo with Pandanus & Charred Herb Salsa over an open fire. He then heads to Darwin, assisting Zach Green at Elijah’s Kitchen, a food truck offering indigenous-inspired meals like Magpie Goose and Crocodile Laksa. Returning to Kakadu, Andy goes fishing with local Barramundi expert Rob Johnson and prepares Paperbark Leaf BBQ Barramundi with Sour Tamarind Sauce at Anbangbang Billabong, showcasing the region's environment and produce.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes 第1季
programme.desc: Bighorn sheep are captured and translocated in the mountains of Nevada.

programme.desc: Conservationists capture and translocate lions across Africa to replenish a once-extinct population.

programme.title: The Force of Nature 2022 第1季
programme.desc: Climate change is our defining crisis, and it is happening even faster than we thought. But we're not powerless to stop it. The impacts of climate change are felt in every corner of the world. Increased temperatures are causing environmental disasters. The sea levels are rising, the Arctic is melting, coral reefs are dying, oceans are acidifying, and forests are burning. It is clear that business as usual is not an option. With climate change reaching irreversible heights, now is the time for bold collective action. The climate emergency is a race we are losing, but it is a race we can win.

programme.title: Secrets of the Great White Shark 2024 第1季
programme.sub-title: Secrets of the Great White Shark
programme.desc: Feature documentary studying the history of the sharks species, alongside their anatomy and how they’ve helped our oceans for hundreds of millions of years. However, in the modern age they face extinction and demonisation. Over 1000 million sharks are killed every year, and it is up to us to save them.

programme.title: Heavy Load 第1季
programme.desc: Heavy transport in the rainforest. For the Sao Manoel hydroelectric power plant in the heart of Brazil, massive elements have to be delivered over a long and arduous route. The transformers weigh more than 200 tonnes each - the way to the destination, almost 4000 kilometres. Heat, dust and dirt roads that are completely dry and full of bumps. The journey becomes dangerous, sometimes it's a matter of centimetres. Then comes the river crossing - with more than 200 tonnes of cargo. The current is unhurried, but what the river swallows is lost. The transport takes seven weeks and delays cost money, breakdowns cost a lot of money - mistakes must not be made here.

programme.title: Get Out Alive with Bear Grylls 第1季
programme.desc: With a low morale at camp, the teams must work together to safely rappel down a dangerous cliff, and face their coldest night thus far. With Robin and Wilson gone, the teams find a new pace, and realize an even playing field translates to stiffer competition.

programme.title: The Force of Nature 2022 第1季
programme.desc: Climate change is our defining crisis, and it is happening even faster than we thought. But we're not powerless to stop it. The impacts of climate change are felt in every corner of the world. Increased temperatures are causing environmental disasters. The sea levels are rising, the Arctic is melting, coral reefs are dying, oceans are acidifying, and forests are burning. It is clear that business as usual is not an option. With climate change reaching irreversible heights, now is the time for bold collective action. The climate emergency is a race we are losing, but it is a race we can win.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: On a wild and dangerous adventure to Mexico, BMX bikers Rooftop and Catfish test how gutsy they really are. The pair go from racing bikes to racing donkeys, flame throwing and tricking in pointy shoes on the streets, to loosing their breakfast trying to eat eyeball tacos for lunch. But the duo’s bravery (or stupidity) doesn’t end there. They compete in a rodeo, milk a snake for its venom, spin upside down as Voladores in a traditional rain ceremony, and get tattoos right before diving into the city’s toxic sewage. With all of these dauntless activities the question becomes, can Rooftop and Catfish make it out of Mexico in one piece.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: Rooftop and Catfish’s travels take them to Romania, where the daredevil acts continue. After a chariot race in the countryside, the BMX bikers continue their attempt to become Romanian gladiators by flying through the air, jumping through flaming walls, and even lighting themselves on fire while riding their bikes. They get up close and personal with the sheep of the country, trying the Romanian delicacy of sheep’s head, but quickly move on to just milking the animal. Finally, the trip to this Eastern European country is not complete without trying to clean up the streets from Romania’s stray dog epidemic. Are Rooftop and Catfish able to save the strays or does the duo learn that they are all bark and no bite.

programme.desc: The contestants are helicoptered to the top of a glacier, where they must navigate unforgiving terrain and dangerous crevasses. With high altitudes and fewer resources, the tasks become more demanding. Divided, the four remaining teams compete for a spot in the final journey.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: A 44-ton Artic straddling the central reservation of the M1 is a rush hour headache for Crouch Recovery Incident Manager Steve and one of the youngest Recovery Ops on the team, Pat. Down South, Lantern Recovery op Steve rescues a broken down 26-ton dustcart from a busy London street. Crouch Recovery op Jim gets drenched as he risks life and limb trying to get a broken-down tractor back to its farm – just a hundred yards away! And Lantern’s night shift recovery op Jason faces a battle to rescue an articulated lorry that’s crashed down a steep ditch off the A1.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: An overturned Gas tanker full of highly flammable propane mean trouble for Crouch Recovery Incident Manager Steve. Working with the fire service he must all his experience to keep his team out of danger. Meanwhile with very little room to manoeuvre Lantern recovery op Steve must rescue a 44-ton artic stuck in a ditch on a busy five lane roundabout. And Lantern Recovery Op Sean has thought on his feet to break into an abandoned truck.

programme.title: David Attenborough A Life on Earth 第1季
programme.sub-title: David Attenborough: A Life on Earth

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第2季
programme.desc: The five remaining celebrities are deep in the heart of the African bush, and with rations running low, Bear challenges them to choose from a selection of edible flora. programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第2季
programme.desc: The celebrities move from the African bush to the coastal forest, where they must learn how to adapt to their new surroundings. As they bed down later, the mood within camp is strained and arguments begin.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: In the South American country of Bolivia, Catfish and Rooftop put their bravery to the test. This duo goes 0 for 2 in the ring testing out their fight skills participating in traditional Tinku fighting and getting smacked down by Bolivia’s Fighting Cholitas. They also face a sketchy ride up death rode just to mountain bike down an equally dangerous path. Catfish has yet to keep a meal down as our bikers try llama brains and Rooftop nearly gets run over as a dancing zebra in the streets. The two top their Bolivian trip off with a trip to the mines on the hunt for silver. With some of the most dangerous activities yet, will Rooftop and Catfish be able to leave Bolivia with just a few bumps and bruises from along the way.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: In the most action packed trip yet, Rooftop and Catfish’s trip to Thailand has them face to face with the country’s nature. They wrestle a crocodile, charm a cobra, and get a massage from an elephant that’s somehow more relaxing than the traditional Thai massages they tried out. The two even attempt to catch (cooked) flying chickens on their heads. Things relaxed in Thailand for a moment when the BMX bikers got to balance out this animal packed experience with the spiritual side of the country, each getting Sak Yant, a traditional Thai tattoo. However, the relaxation was short-lived as Catfish and Rooftops’s final battle in Thailand requires them to make it out of a May Thai boxing match alive.

programme.title: Showdown of the Unbeatables 第1季
programme.desc: This episode of Showdown of the Unbeatables features Brooklyn Bedding memory foam versus the Dynapac CC722 roller; a peanut detecting dog versus the Vortexx Pressure Washer; and Blendtec blenders versus the indestructible Bash sledgehammer.

programme.title: Don't Drive Here 第1季
programme.desc: Getting around this city is like navigating a bee hive...except the bees are driving cars, trucks and trikes.

programme.desc: After a late night of good times, venison chili, and some old school roux the crew heads out for another day of hunting ducks. Adaptability is critical, and after a couple of quick adjustments the team finds themselves back in the ducks.

programme.desc: Billy and Beekeeper Ian extract a bee colony from a family home, then Billy has to dodge talons and beak to remove a Great Horned Owl from a house.

programme.title: Heavy Load 第1季
programme.desc: A pirate ship on a voyage. The Kogas - a retired pirate ship, is to start a new life as a noble restaurant in Berlin. But the journey to get there will be difficult, for the Kogas is docked in Lithuania. A risky and extremely difficult heavy transport over a distance of one thousand kilometres lies ahead. Because the Kogas weighs almost fifty tonnes, a special ship will take it across the Baltic Sea to Poland, and from there across the Oder and the Havel Canal to Berlin. The last journey of the Kogas - a huge logistical task where not everything will always go according to plan.

programme.title: My Second Restaurant in India 第2季
programme.desc: Seeking inspiration for her menu, Sarah immerses herself in Mumbai’s thriving street food scene. Meanwhile delays on the new restaurant kitchen are putting the team behind schedule.

programme.title: My Second Restaurant in India 第2季

programme.title: My Second Restaurant in India 第2季
programme.desc: With only hours before the restaurant is due to open the kitchen remains in chaos. Together with Head Chef Himanil, Sarah must bring some order to the kitchen team as they try to deliver on Sarah’s new menu.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: In the South American country of Bolivia, Catfish and Rooftop put their bravery to the test. This duo goes 0 for 2 in the ring testing out their fight skills participating in traditional Tinku fighting and getting smacked down by Bolivia’s Fighting Cholitas. They also face a sketchy ride up death rode just to mountain bike down an equally dangerous path. Catfish has yet to keep a meal down as our bikers try llama brains and Rooftop nearly gets run over as a dancing zebra in the streets. The two top their Bolivian trip off with a trip to the mines on the hunt for silver. With some of the most dangerous activities yet, will Rooftop and Catfish be able to leave Bolivia with just a few bumps and bruises from along the way.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: In the most action packed trip yet, Rooftop and Catfish’s trip to Thailand has them face to face with the country’s nature. They wrestle a crocodile, charm a cobra, and get a massage from an elephant that’s somehow more relaxing than the traditional Thai massages they tried out. The two even attempt to catch (cooked) flying chickens on their heads. Things relaxed in Thailand for a moment when the BMX bikers got to balance out this animal packed experience with the spiritual side of the country, each getting Sak Yant, a traditional Thai tattoo. However, the relaxation was short-lived as Catfish and Rooftops’s final battle in Thailand requires them to make it out of a May Thai boxing match alive.

programme.desc: Yawn! After a good ol nap let's re-use our pillow covers.

programme.title: 優可 -故事書的結局
programme.desc: When Vik reads a storybook to his friends, Yoko adds some magic that allows the kids to create new parts of the tale.
programme.category: Adventure, Nature, Enironment, Educational, Animation / nan

programme.desc: DiktaThor has invented a ultra-super-magic working juice that everyone in Bhilka wants to get their hands on. But is it really fantastic or just a lie.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -飛毛腿2.0
programme.desc: Sprinter fixes an exoskeleton called 'Sprinter 2.0' so it can help him with his heroic deeds, and of course, Cleopatra immediately set her eyes on it. Unfortunately for both of them, 'Sprinter 2.0' has its own will and has a different plan for itself.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -海洋汙染
programme.desc: A monster is rampaging in the ocean, and Kit and Mr. Battery decide to stop it.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -海溝

programme.desc: While Zoe and Milo warm up inside, Alim suggests skating. The kids doubt it's possible in such cold. To prove them wrong, Alim takes them to Siberia. There, Sergei shows them Siberian life-permafrost, stilt houses, and melting ice for water.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -留尼旺島之旅
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo are surprised by wasps during lunch. Alim says they should be happy to see them. To explain, he takes them to Reunion Island. During a picnic, a swarm of wasps causes panic, but Zoe and Milo learn that on this island, wasps are actually a popular delicacy.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -印度之旅
programme.desc: For hamsters' day, Zoe and Milo want to surprise Alim by making confetti to throw on their little friend. But Alim knows a place on earth where people celebrate by throwing something more interesting than confetti up in the air. Our heroes land in Rajasthan, India.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -韓國之旅
programme.desc: Zoe's mum doesn't like cakes, so Zoe isn't sure what to make for her birthday. Alim suggests visiting their penfriend Kachiko, who lives in South Korea. They meet up with her on the beach.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -蒙蒂休假日
programme.desc: How could we have superpowers? The team flies off to Germany, to borrow some high-tech ‘super' suits. They try using a climbing suit, a jet pack and a powerlifting suit, but none is able to recover the Frisbee.

programme.title: 叢林樂節拍 -犀牛--追逐遊戲

programme.desc: How can microbes be of use at a birthday party? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of microorganisms. Have hands-on fun by experimenting with yeast, and get to know Satoshi Omura, a biochemist, who discovered medicine inside miniscule microbes.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -環境科學

programme.title: 44隻貓 -籃毛球比賽
programme.desc: In view of a game against Boss, Blister and Scab, a former Basketfur champion named Will offers to train the Buffycats and teaches them that sport must be practiced with loyalty, honesty and without tricks.

programme.title: 愛波與小流 -愛波的新朋友
programme.desc: Ebb and Flo are inseparable best friends but Bird arrives and gets in the way. Ebb is upset. Until learning to share is understood. Now Ebb, Bird and Flo are the best of friends. Things couldn't be better.

programme.title: 百變小露露 -魚兒會喝水嗎
programme.desc: It's summer at the beach, and while enjoying coconut water, Luna wonders if fish drink water. With Jupiter and Clyde, she imagines being a fish and dives into the ocean to find out how fish really get the water they need.

programme.title: 留校察看大冒險 -埋藏的寶藏
programme.desc: The last clue leads our heroes to a silent snowy graveyard where they dig up more skeletons than they can handle. The mysterious red cloak villain is revealed, and Kelly must face her past to move ahead.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -巨龍決鬥賽
programme.desc: Rose, Hawk, and the others have a new Dragon Riding Teacher, Sir George, who favors Vicky and dislikes Coach Beast. They settle on a huge dragon tournament at Castle Beast. In the final obstacle course, it's Rose vs. Vicky, but Vicky isn't playing fair.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -貿易路線
programme.desc: Howler and Little Lewis take us on an excursion down the medieval trade routes. The journey is anything but a walk in the park for these two wine merchants! In the Middle Ages, being a salesman takes a lot of guts.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -比武大賽
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, tournaments are all the rage! When Howler's behavior is interpreted of that as a crazed fan, he unwittingly finds himself in the shoes of a knight, embarking on a wild joust.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -艾斯特的一天

programme.title: 畫畫的一百種方式 -迷宮
programme.desc: Draw interlaced paths and choose which one is yours.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -馬可島
programme.desc: Florida sunshine adventure: Waverunners with wild dolphins, airboat through the Everglades, glassblowing lesson testing focus, and soaring on a jetpack above the water. A week of thrilling escapades with Nicole and local teens in Marco Island.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -舊金山

programme.desc: Robbie and Flippy fall out over some fireworks Robbie has bought. With Robbie covered in white powder from an accidental explosion, and Flippy pretending he doesn't exist, Albert is convinced Robbie is a ghost that only he can see.

programme.desc: Robbie and Flippy get into some serious rivalry over who's better at basketball and organise a showdown. Flippy's new trainers turn out to have powers that give him the edge; he looks certain to win, until it all goes wrong.

programme.desc: The team uses crowdfunding to build a dog translation device. When the idea fails, the gang needs to figure out how to make things right with the investors.

programme.desc: Darwin and Newts explore a cave system and discover there's a whole other world underground, with a river, rock formations, and an array of amazing creatures.

programme.desc: Darwin and Newts solve the problem of finding out far things by using a balloon-camera to take an aerial photo.

歡樂家長群
programme.desc: 家長們在群內的爭論不休，孩子們的突發狀況也令人哭笑不得：高宇軒尿床、肖家瑞流口水，徐夢瑤發現初一不見了，只剩一張照片，嚇得大喊……初一從廁所回來後發現原來大家都會出現狀況，對自己有了信心.

programme.title: 夜．遊香港
programme.desc: 經歷香港的夜晚，雖然可以參加不同活動，與朋友聚會，多姿多彩，但更多的晚上，其實是為了自己好好休息，為明天好好充電。. 「夜．遊香港」大結局，主持人蔡明孝(孝仔)會與嘉賓全慧利一起露營，體驗一個「認識自己」的晚上。. 如果日頭的忙碌是一串文字，那麼每個晚上都是一個「逗號」，為的是讓這個名為「人生」的篇章，可以繼續寫下去.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 環球釣魚大冒險
programme.sub-title: 第四集：草原新副本：巨型野生哲羅鮭
programme.desc: 釣魚小隊轉戰蒙古，目標是挑戰巨型野生哲羅鮭。旅程從馬背開始，穿越荒野無人區，挑戰的不只是地形氣候，更是體能與意志的極限.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 英雄們踏上冒險之旅，尋找令森林色彩消褪的元兇。面對巴薩扎與他強大的魔法杖，英雄們集結全部力量，成功解救被巴薩扎操控的吸色巨龍，令森林恢復繽紛色彩.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 沼田町是北海道稻米重鎮之一，現在迎來碩果累累的秋天。我們和兩名北聯女子田徑部成員，一起體驗種植稻米最興奮的環節－收割。沼田町引以為傲的新米美味到難以忘懷.

香港故事：邊境人家
programme.sub-title: Lin Ma Hang: Half a Village
programme.desc: This episode delves into the remote village of Lin Ma Hang, exploring the deep emotional ties of its original inhabitants and the unique rhythm of life in this secluded place. Never abandoned despite its isolation, Lin Ma Hang is home to residents who have lived there for over 70 years. Many, after working in the city, maintain village homes and return as they age, drawn to their ancestral roots. The village hosts the Liu, Yip, and Koon clans, with the Yip surname dominant among permanent residents. Villagers credit the construction of roads and the International Bridge for the village’s survival, though the bridge was closed during the pandemic. Through Lin Ma Hang’s story, this episode showcases the enduring culture and resilience of one of Hong Kong’s rare rural communities, offering a window into its history and emotional bonds.

programme.title: 公訴
programme.desc: 安旎親自走訪詹梅家瞭解案情，決定繼續查惠權。安旎在朱辛殺妻案第二次開庭前再次建議朱辛承認控罪，並說出背後網路賭博的線索。安旎跟何陸源指出根據朱辛案得到的線索，結合了施小虎、張小北等不同受害者的情況，認為有一個更大的罪惡網.

programme.title: 公訴
programme.desc: 朱辛案件挖出的背後的網路賭博線索的追查卻陷入絕境，犯罪分子應該是一群有技術的高智商人群。詹梅的聽證案終於開庭了，安旎提出想要回施小虎帳號。安旎和李儀棠對於案件正面交鋒，李儀棠最終同意免於起訴程式、將施小虎的帳號給到詹梅.

跑者愛也
programme.sub-title: 姜皓文/跑在黑暗找到愛
programme.desc: 〈跑者愛分享〉－姜皓文. 主持梁諾妍（Inez）與姜皓文（黑哥）在將軍澳海濱盡情奔跑，黑哥分享他在跑步過程中的啟發：「不怕慢，只怕停！」這句話成為了他的生活格言。邀請大家一起踏出步伐，探索跑步的樂趣和堅持的力量！. 〈跑者愛迷思〉－跑步慳力有秘訣？. 想跑得更輕鬆、更省力？原來正確跑姿是關鍵！從頭部姿勢、手臂擺動到腳步落地，每個細節都要相互配合，全面掌握正確跑姿，讓你輕鬆提升跑步效率，事半功倍！. 〈跑在黑暗找到愛〉. 傅提芬（Inti），是香港首名完成六大馬的視障跑手。面對黑暗，Inti選擇向前跑，與領跑員丈夫一起跑遍全世界。跑步，讓他們找到光明、找到愛.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈：薩爾斯堡音樂節: 卡普森與康特洛夫
programme.sub-title: 薩爾斯堡音樂節: 卡普森與康特洛夫
programme.desc: 小提琴家卡普森與鋼琴家康特洛夫，他們同樣來自法國，才華橫溢，並在多個國際獎項中屢獲殊榮，被譽為樂壇上一顆璀璨的明星。在今次音樂會上，他們攜手演繹布拉姆斯的三首小提琴與鋼琴奏鳴曲。演奏會在薩爾斯堡莫札特基金會的音樂大廳內舉行，這座音樂廳以其絕佳的音響效果見稱，被視為室內演奏會的理想舉行地點。. 播放頻道： 港台電視31 播出時間： (首播) 2025年9月20日 星期六 下午3時30分 . French violinist Renaud Capuçon and French pianist Alexandre Kantorow, each of them a star in his own right and winners of many international awards, teamed up to play all three sonatas of Johannes Brahms for violin and piano. In the Great Hall of the Salzburg Mozarteum Foundation, ideally suited for the performance of chamber music. . Channel: RTHK 31 Time: (First Run) 2025.9.20 SAT 3:30pm.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台︰浪漫的啟示
programme.desc: 《演藝盛薈．開放舞台》為觀眾帶來多首為愛而生、環環相扣的浪漫時期室內樂作品。克拉拉及羅伯特·舒曼可謂音樂史上最著名的夫妻，而舒曼氏伉儷的作品更是他們的情書。這對戀人幾乎於每首作品中都把愛的密碼隱藏於音符之間。布魯赫（他的妻子亦名克拉拉）年幼時所跟隨的老師，恰巧亦是舒曼鋼協所贈之人。音樂會亦為觀眾呈獻魏恩齊爾於同一時期所撰寫的四中提琴夜曲，優雅動人。. 此演出由比爾斯飛躍演奏音樂節2022音樂家所演奏。各位音樂家從世界各地前往香港，參與2022年初的室內樂音樂節。可惜，音樂節因疫情關係而取消，音樂家將演奏錄影成為《演藝盛薈．開放舞台:浪漫的啓示》，繼續為觀眾呈獻美樂。. 音樂會片段由飛躍演奏香港錄製及提供。. 節目. 克拉拉・舒曼三首中提琴和鋼琴浪漫曲，作品22. 劉子正（中提琴）、張郁苓（鋼琴）. 布魯赫為小提琴、中提琴和鋼琴而寫的八首小品，作品83（選段）. 朱丹（小提琴）、李溢（中提琴）、王致仁（鋼琴）. 魏恩齊爾四中提琴夜曲，作品34. 凌顯祐（中提琴）、陳敏聰（中提琴）、李溢（中提琴）、劉子正（中提琴）. 舒曼降E大調鋼琴四重奏，作品47. 朱丹（小提琴）、劉子正（中提琴）、鮑力卓（大提琴）、左章（鋼琴.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
雙城記-兩岸主播逛香港
programme.desc: 第二集《發現屯門》通過講述屯門的過去、現在，及未來的展望，來發現「不一樣的香港」。兩岸三地的主持人，與嘉賓一起搭上屯馬線及輕鐵，探訪屯門的宜居和交通便捷，同時還有連接內地的地理優勢。通過走訪掃管笏遺址、有「香港千島湖」之稱的大纜涌，屯門陶淵明後人聚居區——藍地等處，帶觀眾瞭解屯門名字的由來，以及過去在香港的地位和作用。而三聖邨，黃金海岸旅遊區、屯門公園、藝術新地標等地，則展現屯門有別於香港市區不同又獨具魅力的自然風光景色.

programme.title: 民生美食關注組
programme.desc: 今集主持阮頌陽（Brian）與林泳怡（Vicky）登上太平山，挑戰盧吉道環迴步行徑，提倡「先鍛鍊、後開餐」的美食哲學。節目內容精彩豐富：Brian 聯同澳洲網紅 Brendan 橫跨港九，品嚐老字號茶餐廳西餅與人氣煲仔飯；Vicky 則與美食博主 Stephen 深入慈雲山，發掘沙嗲牛煲仔麵及創意班蘭雞蛋仔等隱世滋味，帶觀眾從山頂俯瞰美景，再深入社區尋找地道與創新的火花.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮 : 短劇-熱血東江 薪火相傳
十二封信
programme.desc: 2026年，余念終於知曉撫養自己長大的「父親」就是唐亦尋。沈程寫信警告1991年的母親葉海棠遠離唐亦尋，稱他會帶來危險。但透過老師譚鑫之口，他們深信唐亦尋絕不會傷害葉海棠。1991年，收到警告信的二人陷入困惑，與未來的通信卻因郵筒消失而中斷。此時，黑道的威脅步步緊逼，唐亦尋三兄弟被迫接下危險的「最後一單」.

programme.title: 周末大電影：秋天的童話
programme.desc: 年輕貌美的十三妹(鍾楚紅飾)隻身遠赴美國和男友VINCENT (陳百強飾)一同讀書及生活。不料， VINCENT早已移情別戀，並決定與新女友 PEGGY (吳福星飾)移居波士頓。十三妹心灰意冷，開始自我封閉起來，什麼也不聞不問。某天，她險些吸入過量的煤氣身亡，幸得住在樓下的船頭尺(周潤發飾)及時相救才保著性命。在船頭尺的悉心照顧下，十三妹開始重拾自信，面對人生，而二人的關係亦因此變得微妙起來.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
programme.desc: 元宵節是中國民間傳統節日，隨著社會和時代變遷，元宵節的風俗習慣雖然有相當大程度的變化，但仍受到世代重視。活動由九龍樂善堂主辦，展示轄屬中小學及幼稚園學生的藝術作品。學生透過不同藝術品，如繪畫、素描、手工藝、綵燈形式，呈現「一元復始，大地回春」，共賀新春.

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: 「禾下乘涼夢」的理想正在喚醒沉睡的土地，讓希望在鹽鹼荒灘上綻放。在曾被視為「地球之癬」的鹽鹼荒灘上，科技讓稻穗滿滿，創新的技術亦守護「耕地中的大熊貓」。黑地煥發新生機，糧食安全的根基正隨著土地的治癒與日益豐饒而愈加牢固.

programme.title: 義工善行 公務員好故事
programme.desc: 義務工作為社會上有需要的群體帶來希望和光明，發放正能量。公務員事務局於2024年推出「公務員義工嘉許計劃」，以表揚參與或推動義工服務有卓越表現的公務員義工隊及同事，本集會介紹2025年「公務員義工嘉許計劃」的部份得獎義工團隊及獲頒個人獎項的公務員，當中包括：. 懲教署愛羣義工團（警衛犬隊分隊）－ 義工隊憑藉專業的犬隻訓練知識，與動物福利機構合作，每月定期協助訓練待領養犬隻基本禮儀及簡單指令，從而增加被領養的機會，並邀請不同青少年團體參加活動，希望以生命照亮生命，傳遞愛護動物及尊重生命的訊息。. 機電工程署義工隊－義工隊以專業的機電知識，為獨居或雙老長者更換慳電明亮的LED燈泡，並提供家居用電安全資訊和建議。換燈泡一個看似小小的舉動，長者可節省電費之餘，亦大大避免了潛在的家居危機，提升生活質素。.

programme.title: 全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮 : 短劇-熱血東江 薪火相傳
programme.sub-title: 全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮 : 短劇-熱血東江 薪火相傳
programme.desc: 「全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮暨主題講座」，由香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會(國安委)主辦。香港電台除了負責直播之外，亦就當中的青少年短劇表演足本播放，讓公眾更深入了解，一群我們未來的社會棟樑，往祖國遊學時的所見所聞，並透過話劇形式，表達國家安全的重要性以及愛國情懷。特輯旨在提升市民的國家安全意識，並深入淺出讓市民從多角度明白國家安全的重要性、全面性，以及國家安全與全港每一位市民的密切關係.

programme.desc: 2026年，余念終於知曉撫養自己長大的「父親」就是唐亦尋。沈程寫信警告1991年的母親葉海棠遠離唐亦尋，稱他會帶來危險。但透過老師譚鑫之口，他們深信唐亦尋絕不會傷害葉海棠。1991年，收到警告信的二人陷入困惑，與未來的通信卻因郵筒消失而中斷。此時，黑道的威脅步步緊逼，唐亦尋三兄弟被迫接下危險的「最後一單」.

programme.title: 香港故事：邊境人家
programme.sub-title: Lin Ma Hang: Half a Village
programme.desc: This episode delves into the remote village of Lin Ma Hang, exploring the deep emotional ties of its original inhabitants and the unique rhythm of life in this secluded place. Never abandoned despite its isolation, Lin Ma Hang is home to residents who have lived there for over 70 years. Many, after working in the city, maintain village homes and return as they age, drawn to their ancestral roots. The village hosts the Liu, Yip, and Koon clans, with the Yip surname dominant among permanent residents. Villagers credit the construction of roads and the International Bridge for the village’s survival, though the bridge was closed during the pandemic. Through Lin Ma Hang’s story, this episode showcases the enduring culture and resilience of one of Hong Kong’s rare rural communities, offering a window into its history and emotional bonds.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂
programme.desc: 兩段不同香港旅行的回憶，都為餐廳主廚Balram Yadav及老闆Alex P.E.種下一個新的家。印度菜透過香料的搭配，突顯當中的色香味，例如奶油雞、脆餅(Dosa)，而南、北地區更衍生兩地飲食文化風情。Balram兒時受母親的耳濡目染下，就踏上了廚師之路，於多國工作的經驗令他一步一步在香港實現夢想。而Alex不忍多年心愛的飯堂結業，毅然接手餐廳，將素食文化傳承下去。同一地方，但為二人開展人生另一頁.

programme.title: 再登地球之巔
programme.desc: 6,500萬年前，歐亞板塊和印度板塊的碰撞形成了這顆星球上海拔最高、最年輕的自然地理單元----青藏高原。青藏高原的6,500萬年意味着什麼？沿着這把「時間之尺」，科學家們深入可可西里無人區，在崑崙山北麓18公里的剖面上探尋青藏高原的隆起之迷；在4,460米的海拔高度考古人類文明的印記。沿着「時間之尺」，科學家揭示青藏高原的過去、現在和未來.

programme.title: 醫生與你
programme.desc: 大家有沒有聽過「肺動脈高壓」？又稱為「心臟癌症」。根據數字，每100萬人中，約有15至50人患上，屬於極其凶險的罕見病，致命率高，達一半患者會在五年內死亡。不過，只要及早診斷治療，是有助增加存活率。本集請來專科醫生詳細解釋這疾病，更有患者分享患病的心路經歷和接受新療法的效果，加深大眾對肺動脈高壓的認識及關注。. 主持：主持：董光達醫生、鄭萃雯. 嘉賓：阮嘉駿醫生(香港先天性及結構性心臟病學會理事會成員/心臟科專科).

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今次會去北見市參觀菠菜。菠菜在北海道廣泛種植，在冷凍加工過後，不只冬天，現在一整年都可以吃到。以現時的技術，可以令你分不清新鮮和冷凍菠菜之間的分別.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 逸飛發明了智慧管家球球2.0，讓灶君感到強所未有的危機，唯恐球球2.0奪走自己的寵愛，灶君和球球2.0展開激烈角逐，沒想到灶君遭遇危機，危急時刻球球2.0舍生救助，灶君隨化解心結.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 莎莎無意間看到女兒日記，誤以為女兒說自己不是個可靠的好媽媽，灶君由此對莎莎展開了「完美媽媽」特訓，卻失敗，萬念俱灰的莎莎被女兒邀請聽自己的日記，原來是自己沒看完日記，媽媽雖然不完美但在女兒心裡是全世界最好的媽媽.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 菲菲和如福在三里屯意外撞壞了大周周的吉他。菲菲決定幫助大周周週實現登台演出的願望，如福們幫助修好吉他並做好造型。準備就緒後，大周周在菲菲的鼓勵下勇敢走上舞台.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 菲菲陪敦敦在景山放風箏，風箏斷線飛走了。菲菲召集如福侍衛隊尋找風箏。朝風製造颶風，將菲菲和風箏捲上天空。福珠激發出強大能量，保護了菲菲。菲菲在空中發現了萬春亭頂上的寶盒.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 守護天堂
programme.desc: 榮列世界新七大自然奇觀之一的伊瓜蘇瀑布，以其橫跨3公里的275條瀑布成為世界上最大規模的瀑布群。然而，在這個當前經濟蓬勃發展的地區，如何在保護這個生態瑰寶的同時，推動旅遊業發展？. 受惠於阿根廷和巴西建立的多個國家公園，這片瀑布位於一片擁有獨特生物多樣性的廣闊森林核心地帶。瀑布周邊棲息著約422種鳥類，包括色彩絢麗的鞭笞巨嘴鳥、於瀑布後方築巢的大黑雨燕，以及對森林再生至關重要的黑額鳴冠雉。除此之外，這片地區還有猴子、長鼻浣熊及南美小食蟻獸，以及南美僅存的貓科動物，例如威嚴的美洲豹及敏捷的美洲獅。每年該地區接待超過300萬名遊客，為了把人類對動物的影響降至最低，遊客只能進入保護區的小部分地方。科學家和森林管理員不斷努力，保護動物免受偷獵的威脅，並教育當地居民如何與貓科動物和諧共處。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2025年5月20日 星期二 晚上10時. . The Iguazu Falls, one of the 7 wonders of the planet, are the biggest in the world with their 275 cascades on 3 kilometers. But, how to reconcile today this ecological treasure with the development of tourism, in a region in full economic boom?. Thanks to the creation of several national parks in Argentina and Brazil, they are in the heart of a vast forest with unique biodiversity. The area of the falls is home to 422 species of birds, from the majestic toucans to the great dusky swifts, which nest behind the falls, or the grey-fronted guans, essential for the regeneration of the forest. . In addition to populations of monkeys, coatis, and tamanduas, the region is also home to some of the last felines in South America, including the majestic jaguar or the agile puma. The site receives more than 3 million tourists per year. To minimize their impact on the fauna, they only have access to a small part of the protected area. Scientists and rangers are fighting relentlessly to protect the fauna from poaching and to educate the local population to live together with the felines. . Bilingual: Cantonese / English (TV version & Web version) . Time: (First run) 2025.05.20 TUE 10pm.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: In 2024, the government introduced a regulatory scheme for “Basic Housing Units.” The standards and guidelines require features such as independently partitioned toilets and set ventilation requirements. The new rules aim to raise living standards and provide low‑income families with a safe and reasonably habitable environment. In this episode, we will explore with you.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
programme.desc: 元宵節是中國民間傳統節日，隨著社會和時代變遷，元宵節的風俗習慣雖然有相當大程度的變化，但仍受到世代重視。活動由九龍樂善堂主辦，展示轄屬中小學及幼稚園學生的藝術作品。學生透過不同藝術品，如繪畫、素描、手工藝、綵燈形式，呈現「一元復始，大地回春」，共賀新春.

programme.title: 香港故事 - 老店情未了第二季 (英文版)
programme.sub-title: Grande Dame of the Far East: Majestic Makeover
programme.desc: In 1970, 42 years after the opening of the hotel, its management was in the hands of Baron Lawrence Kadoorie and Sir Michael Kadoorie of the establishment’s founding family. With father and son both being avid car enthusiasts, a decision was made to introduce a limousine fleet. . The more famous the hotel became, the more VIPs stayed there. To cope with the increasing number of guests, it was necessary to extend the original 6-storey building. The works for adding a 30-storey new wing to the north tower then commenced in 1991 to include a rooftop restaurant, spa, and other modern facilities. A helipad was even put in place, making the hotel accessible by land, sea, and air.

programme.title: 公訴
programme.desc: 根據取得的施小虎遊戲帳號，檢察院和公安方面發現了施小虎可能認識張小北，以及眾多大學生有類似網貸情況的事實，直指可能網貸已經深入校園。安旎和何陸源深入大學調查取證並獲得關鍵線索，意識到惠權遊戲也在大學蔓延.

programme.title: 公訴
programme.desc: 安旎再次提審723案件的犯人李全，供出誰是真的老A。政法委組織各部門聯席會議，要求對非法網貸的深入調查。檢察院對近期頻受爭議的惠權遊戲作出《檢察建議書》，法務部的李儀棠和羅江孝連夜自查自糾，對公眾作出願意整改產品的聲明.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
programme.desc: 元宵節是中國民間傳統節日，隨著社會和時代變遷，元宵節的風俗習慣雖然有相當大程度的變化，但仍受到世代重視。活動由九龍樂善堂主辦，展示轄屬中小學及幼稚園學生的藝術作品。學生透過不同藝術品，如繪畫、素描、手工藝、綵燈形式，呈現「一元復始，大地回春」，共賀新春.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 中國歷史上，每逢亂世苛政，總有人落草為寇、揭竿而起。從陳勝吳廣到李自成，從梁山好漢到太平天國，他們或被視為盜賊匪徒，或被尊為義士英雄，亦正亦邪之間，折射出底層百姓的苦難與抗爭，本集將探討草莽人物在史書與文學中截然不同的面貌。. 主持. 曾卓然(嶺南大學中文系哲學博士). 譚家齊(香港浸會大學歷史系副教授). 謝偉傑(香港中文大學歷史系副教授). 吳海傑(香港大學法律學院教授及副院長(研究).

programme.title: 跑者愛也
programme.desc: 第二集結伴跑. 〈跑者愛分享〉－蔡一智. 主持梁諾妍（Inez）與蔡一智（智哥）在大潭水務文物徑暢跑，享受雨後清新的大自然氣息！智哥熱愛運動，深信「健康，就是送給家人最好的禮物」。他以自身經驗鼓勵大家及早儲備健康資本，跑出快樂、跑出健康！. 〈跑者愛迷思〉－「超慢跑」有幾慢？. 近年流行的「超慢跑」，是一種低強度且輕鬆自在的有氧運動方式，速度介於步行與慢跑之間，有效降低關節負擔。這種跑步方式不僅適合不同年齡群組，更是初學者友善的入門運動，在家也能輕鬆練習，隨時隨地開啟健康之旅！. 〈結伴跑〉. 長跑運動員黃啟樂，自中學時受恩師啟蒙，踏上跑步旅程。一路奔跑，他在不同階段遇到許多生命中的良師益友，與及互相支持的另一半映潮。從校園操場到競技跑道，從跑步愛好者到專業運動員兼教練，每次結伴同行的經歷都給他帶來了深刻的啟發與成長.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：粵劇 牡丹亭驚夢
programme.sub-title: 粵劇 牡丹亭驚夢 (上集)
programme.desc: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：粵劇牡丹亭驚夢(上集). 《牡丹亭驚夢》是著名劇作家唐滌生，改編傳統崑劇《牡丹亭》而成的粵劇。. 故事講述宋朝太守之女杜麗娘在牡丹亭夢到書生柳夢梅而相戀，麗娘醒後思憶成疾而死，. 後來麗娘回生與夢梅結為夫婦，怎料不為麗娘父親杜寶認可，最後在皇帝調停下終能團圓。. 著名粵劇演員龍貫天與多位粵劇界年青新星傾力演出，配合全新舞台佈景燈光設計，展現. 粵劇美學新境界。. 粵劇片段由香港粵劇藝術團提供。. 表演者：. 龍貫天飾皇帝. 黃成彬飾柳夢梅. 劉麗飾杜麗娘. 梁煒康飾陳最良. 黎耀威飾杜寶. 吳敏婷飾春香.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 唱作歌手李靖筠(Gladys)近年嘗試R&B慵懶風格，同樣身為唱作人的布志綸(Alan)，作品就揉合搖滾、抒情，風格多變。兩位將同時上《港樂．講樂》的舞台現場演唱最新派台歌，更會一齊大玩遊戲！. 主持. 阮頌陽. 歌曲：. 李靖筠《最好比我更懶》. 布志綸《貼哋.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
好鄰居齊學基本法-校園 Special
programme.desc: 有小鄰居覺得媽媽不但在網上處處監察自己，還沒收手機，害他失去「通訊自由」，所以急急地向Harry哥哥求救。可是，貓頭鷹博士根據《基本法》第三十條，認為事情未必如他所想。到底小鄰居是否有所誤會？而媽媽這樣做又是否另有原因呢？. 《基本法》第三十條：. 香港居民的通訊自由和通訊秘密受法律的保護。除因公共安全和追查刑事犯罪的需要，由有關機關依照法律程序對通訊進行檢查外，任何部門或個人不得以任何理由侵犯居民的通訊自由和通訊秘密。. . 節目由政制及內地事務局與香港電台聯合製作.

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: 將廣闊國土上的陽光、勁風與江河之力轉化為驅動未來的綠色動能，用沙漠陽光點亮萬家燈火，讓工廠流淌綠色電流。當「啟航號」風車的巨臂劃破長空，捕獲大自然之力，加上「零碳」工廠在黑暗中高效運轉，我們看見清潔能源正在重塑中國製造的基因.

programme.title: IP 新機遇 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 「IP 經濟」指知識產權（Intellectual Property）的商業化應用，是一種將原創動漫角色、故事等轉化為商品、授權等的商業模式。香港一家創意工作室，多年來透過取得版權授權，舉辦眾多深受市民大眾歡迎的展覽和活動。. 本集將從「超級聯繫人」及被授權方的角度，了解更多對知識產權保護的重要性，及探討香港發展「IP 經濟」的潛力和經濟影響.

programme.title: 西藏·星空下的傳奇
programme.desc: 《星晴》循著藏曆的時間韻律，講述高原上與星空交織的追夢傳奇。 90後自由術家安念初紮根西藏十年，將納木措銀河凝於筆端，以3D壁畫喚醒恰村活力，讓藝術成為鄉村振興，文旅融合的星火.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 母親節是一個表達感謝和愛意的時刻。無論是你的媽媽、岳母、外婆還是任何其他特別的母親，許多人都會在母親節送一份有心思的禮物讓對方感到幸福與專屬。世界各地的母親節的日期有所不同，香港的母親節就是每年五月第二個周日。韓國沒有母親節也沒有父親節，他們將5月8日定為「父母節」，印尼母親節是每年12月22日，各地都有不同的慶祝方式。.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
十二封信
programme.desc: 2026年，唐亦尋的兄弟「耗子」現身，講述當年悲劇真相。1991年，三兄弟為家人鋌而走險執行「最後一單」，卻發現所謂的「貨物」竟是遭綁架的同學沈曉軍。黑道欲放火燒死二人並嫁禍，危急時刻，葉海棠衝入火場救出唐亦尋和沈曉軍，自己卻留下傷疤。員警趕到，真相大白，但三兄弟的命運已被改寫.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
周末大電影 : 海外特派員
programme.desc: At the beginning of 1939, Jones, an American reporter, is sent by his paper to Europe. There, he is to investigate the possibility of a world war. In London, he meets an elderly Dutch politician, co-signatory of a secret alliance treaty whose details the Nazis will stop at nothing to discover. The old man is kidnapped.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 承接上集，戴祖儀跟羅啟豪這對一動一靜的新鮮組合，繼續與眾同樂。羅啟豪獻上自己的第一首國語歌曲《畫中密碼》，戴祖儀深情演繹《由他》，兩人更邀請粉絲上台玩遊戲，為《港樂．講樂》期間限定音樂會帶來熾熱氣氛.

programme.desc: 榮列世界新七大自然奇觀之一的伊瓜蘇瀑布，以其橫跨3公里的275條瀑布成為世界上最大規模的瀑布群。然而，在這個當前經濟蓬勃發展的地區，如何在保護這個生態瑰寶的同時，推動旅遊業發展？. 受惠於阿根廷和巴西建立的多個國家公園，這片瀑布位於一片擁有獨特生物多樣性的廣闊森林核心地帶。瀑布周邊棲息著約422種鳥類，包括色彩絢麗的鞭笞巨嘴鳥、於瀑布後方築巢的大黑雨燕，以及對森林再生至關重要的黑額鳴冠雉。除此之外，這片地區還有猴子、長鼻浣熊及南美小食蟻獸，以及南美僅存的貓科動物，例如威嚴的美洲豹及敏捷的美洲獅。每年該地區接待超過300萬名遊客，為了把人類對動物的影響降至最低，遊客只能進入保護區的小部分地方。科學家和森林管理員不斷努力，保護動物免受偷獵的威脅，並教育當地居民如何與貓科動物和諧共處。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2025年5月20日 星期二 晚上10時. . The Iguazu Falls, one of the 7 wonders of the planet, are the biggest in the world with their 275 cascades on 3 kilometers. But, how to reconcile today this ecological treasure with the development of tourism, in a region in full economic boom?. Thanks to the creation of several national parks in Argentina and Brazil, they are in the heart of a vast forest with unique biodiversity. The area of the falls is home to 422 species of birds, from the majestic toucans to the great dusky swifts, which nest behind the falls, or the grey-fronted guans, essential for the regeneration of the forest. . In addition to populations of monkeys, coatis, and tamanduas, the region is also home to some of the last felines in South America, including the majestic jaguar or the agile puma. The site receives more than 3 million tourists per year. To minimize their impact on the fauna, they only have access to a small part of the protected area. Scientists and rangers are fighting relentlessly to protect the fauna from poaching and to educate the local population to live together with the felines. . Bilingual: Cantonese / English (TV version & Web version) . Time: (First run) 2025.05.20 TUE 10pm.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 多元族裔人士要尋找工作一向不容易，如學歷不高、言語不通，可以選擇的工種未必會很多，加上文化差異，在職場亦可能會感到壓力。今集主持Wimmy 和主持成家宏會和巴基斯坦裔的阿文Minhas Rashad，大家一齊食零食、傾下計，暢談多元族裔人士在香港生活的工作的現況.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂
programme.desc: 本集帶你越過南北之分，尋找隱身香港的河內家鄉味。店主Kenny與Julie堅持小店用心，每週親手空運食材、甚至搬運越南擺設回港，只為重現最地道的北越風情，例如河內牛柳粉和米紙卷。這裡沒有宣傳攻勢，卻有熟客為他們寫文拍片、首飾店主動提出聯乘。一碗湯粉背後，是兩個香港人對越南味道的執著，與食客結下的真摯緣分.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 鹽分兩面睇
programme.desc: 鹽是珍貴的物資，對我們的生存至關重要。但這種「白色黃金」是否已構成對地球末來的威脅？ 世界各地的科學家對鹽化問題日益關注。這個現象對全球珍貴的淡水儲備有甚麼影響？ 鹽擁有非凡的潛力及多樣性，然而，隨著大海的鹹水不斷侵蝕沿岸土地，鹽掛上污染地下水和破壞農牧業的污名。大眾開始警覺鹽對他們的生活、生計，及文化都會大受威脅。 然而，近年有人研究利用鹽來儲電或用於建築用途。本集節目揭示鹽的力量密碼，細訴鹽如何改變綠色能源生產，開闢通往永續建築材料的道路。. Salt – precious and essential for survival. But has this white gold also become a threat to the future of our planet?. Scientists around the world are growing increasingly concerned about salinization. What does this mean for the world's precious freshwater reserves? With its incredible versatility and potential, however, salt also emerges as a promising protagonist of a greener tomorrow. Join us as we unlock the secrets of salt's power to revolutionize green energy production and forge a path towards sustainable building materials.

programme.desc: 「沒有歌，怎敢說心事」，一首好的作品除了要有動聽的旋律外，亦要歌手動人的演繹，才能成為經典作品。歌手們日常用聲限制，又要戒吃辣，小心用聲，都只想將動聽作品送給各位樂迷。今集「實力唱將」系列精選多首實力歌手之作，讓大家可以再三回味他們的演出。. 主持. 阮頌陽.

programme.title: 31看世界 – 維克托的極限清單2
programme.sub-title: 蘇格蘭 高地運動會
programme.desc: 在蘇格蘭「高地運動會」絕非只是魁梧大力士在草地上角力的比賽，更是一場歷史悠久的文化慶典。. 在氏族征戰的歲月，體能是生存的重要門檻。早期的氏族首領透過投擲比賽，選拔精銳的勇士。時至今日，這種選拔方式已轉化為每年五至八月的年度盛事。每年夏天，蘇格蘭高地各社區都會舉辦專屬的高地運動會，穿上蘇格蘭裙的選手們，透過舉石、擲鐵鎚、拋木柱等項目，彼此較勁，在承傳著傳統之餘，也是身分認同與團結的展現。. 在這次旅程，維克托走訪高地運動會和世界大力士大賽的選手們，並在他們的指導下，親身挑戰在蘇格蘭著名的「延文禮士高地運動會」。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/法語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2026年5月12日 星期二 晚上10時. . The Scottish Highland Games are far more than a mere display of brute strength or a collection of athletic competitions. They are a profound celebration of the area’s storied history and cultural heritage. In an era when a warrior’s physical prowess was a matter of survival, clan chieftains used these tests of strength and skill to identify, recruit, and train the finest fighters in the land. . Today, this tradition thrives from May through August as communities across the Highlands host their own games. Athletes, clad in traditional kilts, compete in iconic events such as the stone put, hammer throw, and the legendary caber toss, pushing the boundaries of human power. . programme.title: 全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮 : 短劇-熱血東江 薪火相傳
programme.sub-title: 全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮 : 短劇-熱血東江 薪火相傳
programme.desc: 「全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮暨主題講座」，由香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會(國安委)主辦。香港電台除了負責直播之外，亦就當中的青少年短劇表演足本播放，讓公眾更深入了解，一群我們未來的社會棟樑，往祖國遊學時的所見所聞，並透過話劇形式，表達國家安全的重要性以及愛國情懷。特輯旨在提升市民的國家安全意識，並深入淺出讓市民從多角度明白國家安全的重要性、全面性，以及國家安全與全港每一位市民的密切關係.

programme.title: 31看世界 – 維克托的極限清單2
programme.sub-title: 蘇格蘭 高地運動會
programme.desc: 在蘇格蘭「高地運動會」絕非只是魁梧大力士在草地上角力的比賽，更是一場歷史悠久的文化慶典。. 在氏族征戰的歲月，體能是生存的重要門檻。早期的氏族首領透過投擲比賽，選拔精銳的勇士。時至今日，這種選拔方式已轉化為每年五至八月的年度盛事。每年夏天，蘇格蘭高地各社區都會舉辦專屬的高地運動會，穿上蘇格蘭裙的選手們，透過舉石、擲鐵鎚、拋木柱等項目，彼此較勁，在承傳著傳統之餘，也是身分認同與團結的展現。. 在這次旅程，維克托走訪高地運動會和世界大力士大賽的選手們，並在他們的指導下，親身挑戰在蘇格蘭著名的「延文禮士高地運動會」。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/法語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2026年5月12日 星期二 晚上10時. . The Scottish Highland Games are far more than a mere display of brute strength or a collection of athletic competitions. They are a profound celebration of the area’s storied history and cultural heritage. In an era when a warrior’s physical prowess was a matter of survival, clan chieftains used these tests of strength and skill to identify, recruit, and train the finest fighters in the land. . Today, this tradition thrives from May through August as communities across the Highlands host their own games. Athletes, clad in traditional kilts, compete in iconic events such as the stone put, hammer throw, and the legendary caber toss, pushing the boundaries of human power. . In this journey, Victor connects with elite athletes from the Highland Games and the World’s Strongest Man circuit. Mentored by these titans of strength, he steps into the arena to personally take on the challenge of Scotland’s prestigious Inverness Highland Games. . Bilingual: Cantonese / French (TV version) . Time: (First run) 2026.05.12 Tue, 10pm.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 細味風情
programme.desc: 薩伏依是法國最美麗的地區之一，以壯麗的山脈、優秀的建築、刺激的冬季活動、才華橫溢的藝術家和獨特的美食而聞名。 作為法國阿爾卑斯山脈的心臟地帶，由於滑雪熱潮，一些村莊已成為極端奢華的代名詞。如今，谷雪維爾(Courchevel)，或者伊澤爾河谷(Val d'Isère)等地的名字，已經比薩伏依更為家喻戶曉。然而，這個特殊地區的山谷帶有更深層次的魅力，而非僅有華麗的表面。本節目將帶您穿越薩伏依的雪域，探索其多的真實性及其迷人之處。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2024年8月20日 星期二晚上10時30分.

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: 將廣闊國土上的陽光、勁風與江河之力轉化為驅動未來的綠色動能，用沙漠陽光點亮萬家燈火，讓工廠流淌綠色電流。當「啟航號」風車的巨臂劃破長空，捕獲大自然之力，加上「零碳」工廠在黑暗中高效運轉，我們看見清潔能源正在重塑中國製造的基因.

programme.title: IP 新機遇 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 「IP 經濟」指知識產權（Intellectual Property）的商業化應用，是一種將原創動漫角色、故事等轉化為商品、授權等的商業模式。香港一家創意工作室，多年來透過取得版權授權，舉辦眾多深受市民大眾歡迎的展覽和活動。. 本集將從「超級聯繫人」及被授權方的角度，了解更多對知識產權保護的重要性，及探討香港發展「IP 經濟」的潛力和經濟影響.

programme.desc: 冰冰不滿其他英雄將她能夠飛行的力量視為理所當然，因此當她遇上仙女小隊時，她決定離開英雄團隊，轉投仙女小隊的任務團隊。不過，她很快就意識到，和自己最投契的，其實是熱愛野餐及狂歡的快樂英雄團隊.

programme.desc: 今集會參觀食用百合生產地美瑛町。原來種植百合的時間相當驚人，需要六年才能供以食用。另外亦會介紹最適合除夕新年的百合菜式.

programme.title: 歡樂家長群
programme.sub-title: 第十四集：張文萍監督果寧上網課
programme.desc: 張文萍學成歸來，準備大展身手的和果寧來一場「監督對決」，不料劉向上和戴靜提前歸家，讓張文萍學習的監督網課的方法無處施展，十分失落。劉向上和戴靜商量後假意稱各自工作忙，張文萍感覺找回自己的價值，內心暗喜.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 我家是個博物館
programme.sub-title: 第5集 : 樂器、積木熊的收藏
programme.desc: 石磊，一位收藏了近百件稀有樂器的獨立音樂人，他收藏的樂器來自世界各大洲，最長的歷史可達千年。另一名收藏者「熊人」高可，收藏有上千隻限量版積木熊，這讓他成功申請到吉尼斯世界紀錄.

programme.title: 民生美食關注組
programme.desc: 今集主持阮頌陽（Brian）與林泳怡（Vicky）登上太平山，挑戰盧吉道環迴步行徑，提倡「先鍛鍊、後開餐」的美食哲學。節目內容精彩豐富：Brian 聯同澳洲網紅 Brendan 橫跨港九，品嚐老字號茶餐廳西餅與人氣煲仔飯；Vicky 則與美食博主 Stephen 深入慈雲山，發掘沙嗲牛煲仔麵及創意班蘭雞蛋仔等隱世滋味，帶觀眾從山頂俯瞰美景，再深入社區尋找地道與創新的火花.

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.sub-title: 第八集: 心動的次數

承歡記
programme.sub-title: 第二十集：祖母將興安里交承歡營運
programme.desc: 姚志明因意外的遺囑分配，震驚離場，興安里歸承歡讓他陷入兩難，他提議用獨立屋交換興安里，卻遭承歡質疑他的動機。承歡拒絕交換遺產，決心親自接下興安里。原來興安里酒店的營運情况不健康，承歡媽媽又到興安里的餐廳吃飯並找問題，承歡能否改善興安里酒店的營運.

programme.title: 承歡記
programme.sub-title: 第二十一集：興安里爆發食物中毒危機
programme.desc: 麥承歡剛接手興安里，餐廳就爆發食物中毒危機，承歡憑藉酒店的工作經驗，安撫顧客情緒，並控制事件發酵。承歡與姚志明聯手找到食物中毒當事人，承歡約當時人出來並拆穿了他的謊言，拿到澄清視頻。姚志明揭穿幕後黑手應該是張培生，承歡能否守護興安里.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 一陣陣可怕的哀嚎響徹森林，所有居民都徹夜難眠。菲斯委派英雄們去找出這些聲音的來源，一眾英雄最初誤以為是垂柳家族發出的哭聲，後來才發現聲音是由一條陷入困境的巨龍所發出.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 名寄市在嚴寒中種植菠菜。我們一起去了解菠菜如何在白雪皚皚、寒冷的北海道北部生長。寒冷會使蔬菜變甜。而驚人的含糖量究竟是多少呢？最後，我們吃了農民推薦的菠菜菜餚.

programme.title: 歡樂家長群
programme.sub-title: 第十五集：果寧要為果寶打架報仇
programme.desc: 果寧要為果寶打架報仇，沒想到姜飛虎不僅不承認，就連肖家瑞也矢口否認自己和媽媽說過看到姜飛虎踢了果寶，鬧了一場烏龍。王老師非常嚴肅地在班裏重申了不可以欺負別人、不可以撒謊的事情，讓果寶若有所思.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團
programme.sub-title: 第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團 - 北京及山東
programme.desc: 由外交部駐港公署、教育局，與明天更好基金聯合主辦「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽」已於五月份圓滿舉行。比賽過後，一眾優勝學生獲香港賽馬會特別贊助，參加內地參訪團，用腳步丈量神州大地的壯麗山河，用心來感受國家現代化建設的偉大成就，增加對國家的歸屬感和國民身份認同。. 參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的學生分別不同的中學。參訪團分別到訪北京、曲阜，泰安，潍坊，威海以及青島等地，亦會參觀景點，如故宫博物院、釣魚台、中國甲午戰爭博物館、總體國家安全觀主题展館等，更有機會旁聽外交部例行記者會並與青年外交官座談。. 節目會紀錄學生參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的全部過程，總結行程的所思所感，以體驗的形式學習、了解國情，以帶出學生將課本知識與考察內容有效地結合，對國家在科技、文化、經濟發展有更深一層認識.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
31看世界 - 環球釣魚大冒險
programme.sub-title: 第五集：這裏真沒魚：巨人虎魚（上集）
programme.desc: 這一集三人來到非洲的剛果河，挑戰傳説中的巨人虎魚，已經很久沒人釣到牠,，三人帶找着魚竿和好奇、闖入這篇深邃的河流，看看是傳説現身，還是證明牠只是傳説.

programme.title: 相會雙城
programme.sub-title: 相會雙城 - 咫尺之情 (上)
programme.desc: 這是一個跨越七十年的故事：相會於上海與香港之間，亦連繫着家鄉寧波奉化的記憶與溫度的延續。. 五十年代初，上海解放後，很多人帶着資金及技術湧入香港，當時26歲的張子斌在上海學得一手紅幫裁縫技藝，為了生計，他帶着僅有的十元美金，飄洋過海前往香港打拼。張子斌在香港落地生根，開設男士定制服裝店Ascot Chang，以穩妥的品質建立口碑，也為日後的傳承奠定根基。. 後來，張子斌身體抱恙，召回留學美國、剛剛大學畢業的兒子張宗琪（Tony）協助經營。原本對裁縫一竅不通的Tony，一做便做了四十多年，他秉承爸爸對品質的堅持、技術的追求，緊緊追隨爸爸的足跡。. 當內地改革開放帶來新機遇，九十年代Tony回到父親學藝及安居立業的上海，開設內地第一間分店，希望把家族事業帶到更廣闊的地方。同時，他亦延續爸爸回饋家鄉的善行，在寧波奉化為鄉鎮的小學捐錢興建新教學樓。. 為了拉近下一代與家鄉的距離，Tony安排兒子張奕庭（Justin）到農村小學當小老師，教授英文，讓Justin在日常相處中理解回鄉的意義。近年，他又以修葺祖墳作為起點，希望家族可以有一個回來聚首的地方。這份相會不只停留在上海與香港，更在寧波奉化的土地上，延續成一種長久的連結.

programme.title: 香港故事:尾巴會說話(英文版)
醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康
programme.sub-title: #10 Honey: A Taste of Nature’s Sweetness
programme.desc: With a mild taste, honey is the natural syrup endowed on us by the nature. It is said that in terms of blood glucose control, honey is better than ordinary sugar because of its natural ingredients. But is this true? In this episode of “Eat Well Live Well”, we will explore the nutritional value of honey. The two “Food Fanatic” visit a bee master to learn about the process and difficulties of beekeeping, and have a taste of the fresh and delicious honey from the honeycomb on the spot. . Hong Kong people love honey. Apart from honey water, honey is most commonly used for seasoning in barbecues. This time, Chef Will will make a dish “ Honeyed Chicken Wing Dumplings with Honey-Roasted Sweet Potatoes”; and Specialist in Endocrinology, Diabetes and Metabolism Dr Rose TING, and artiste Deon CHEUNG are invited to share their thoughts while enjoying the delicious food. Being middle-aged, Deon CHEUNG is particularly concerned about diet. What health preservation tips does he have? There is a saying amongst the public that honey is a boon to diabetics. Is this true? Let’s see what Dr TING says. . Hosts: Snowy CHOI, Will LEUNG (Chef). Guests: Deon CHEUNG, Dr Rose TING (Specialist in Endocrinology, Diabetes and Metabolism).

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: The south-to-north water diversion mega project showcases how China gets along with its water environment. The endless supply of pristine water to the north is made possible by countless committed water guardians. When rare birds return to Xixi Wetland, and peach blossom jellyfish become water quality indicators, we realise that living rivers are the genes that preserve civilization.

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: From the marine ranch of Yellow Sea, to the mangroves of South China Sea. From the “Oriental Swan Kingdom”, to the verdant resurgence in Hainan. Under such blessings, the ecosystem is reborn anew. Whooper swans have now returned to Rongcheng, while egrets have settled down in Lingshui. These homecomers are living proof of a revived ecology. With mangroves forming an ecological shield, and marine ranches serving as green granaries. Here, where corals, seagrass and mangroves co-exist, the Nature bestows a blue medal upon China’s marine governance.

programme.title: Chill綠世代
programme.desc: From the hustle and bustle of New York to the Utah desert, from offices in Silicon Valley to the Texas ranches, the United States appears as a land of paradoxes and of extremes, which leaves no one indifferent. Land of immigration since always, the country fascinates with the strength of a promise: the one of a life where anything is possible. To our Green Heroes the American dream is that of a transition to healthy agriculture and sustainable, responsible architecture and a more humble way of life.
